data.name: Sandeep
data.gender_notes: Sandeep is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit saṃ, 'fully', + dīp, 'to shine' — 'a lighted lamp'. Its root is Sanskrit saṃ + dīp. A classical Sanskrit term for a lamp. Sandeep is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lighted lamp; blazing”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sandeep expresses “Lighted lamp; blazing”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit saṃ, 'fully', + dīp, 'to shine' — 'a lighted lamp'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sandeep total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: Sandeep

Sandeep is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lighted lamp; blazing”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.cultural_impact: Sandeep is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Lighted lamp; blazing”.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Lighted lamp; blazing” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Sandeep; such symbolism is interpretive.

vedic_reference.note: The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sandip' which means 'the one who brings light'. It is a common name in Hinduism and appears in various Hindu texts and mythologies.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for a lamp.
